text:
kelly (People Ops): Need quick routing advice: hiring wants an above-band base + small sign-on for an internal transfer (ID 6210). Is this a comp-band exception or an internal uplift exception?

ben (Recruiter): Candidate: Marcus Lee (internal). Proposed FT comp: base $118k, sign-on $5k one-time, start Apr 10. L4 band cap is $105k. Manager wants to lock before end of month.

tori (Hiring Manager): Marcus leads our infra test automation. If we can't move him fast he'll likely accept another internal ask. Asking exec-comp for an exception to accelerate. Happy to add a 3-line business impact note.

omar (Finance): Need run-rate + one-time calculation and cost center. Quick calc:
```base=118000
benefits=base*0.22 (~25960)
one_time=5000
est_1yr_cost=148960```
Also need confirmation that internal headcount slot is available.

lina (Legal): Note: internal transfers need re-onboarding forms and benefits vendor notification for earlier eligibility if requested. Any change to equity or sign-on needs exec-comp + equity team sign-off.

kelly (People Ops): Plan: I'll open APPR-5077, attach offer draft, finance calc, and your manager note. Requesting 48hr review window and flagging as "internal-transfer-urgent". Ben please upload offer + internal approval doc.

ben (Recruiter): Uploaded /files/MarcusL-offer.pdf and internal approval doc at https://docs.internal/6210-internal-approval. Candidate ok with Apr 10 pending approvals.

approvals-bot: Approval request created: APPR-5077. Status: pending. Routed to: exec-comp, finance, benefits, legal. SLA: 48 hours. Link: https://approvals.internal/APPR-5077

omar (Finance): I'll provisionally approve the one-time sign-on if recruiting maps GL string SIG-ONE-42 and headcount confirmed.

tori (Hiring Manager): I'll add the business impact note now. Available for a quick sync if exec-comp asks for color.

kelly (People Ops): If approved we'll mark start date "pending benefits and payroll repapering" and include conditional language for sign-on. Please react with :thumbsup: when you've left your note on APPR-5077.

(tori) :thumbsup: (omar) :thumbsup: (lina) :eyes:
